notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.398 (Default), firmware rev27v-followup-355.

After orderly worker/device/recording/settings/log cleanup and flushing, Windows ends only the current process without DLL unload callbacks. Owned preference stores are synced without scanning arbitrary Qt objects. The final exit record follows flushing. Compiler environments exclude inherited service credentials.
Compiled build validation now requires matching process logs with a clean exit;
native faults, terminal/settings failures and incomplete evidence reject the build.
The offline verification fixture isolates operator preferences.

294 focused source checks, seven project checks, layout audit and GUI smoke pass.
The retained397 log/replay exposes a hidden native shutdown fault despite exit0;
this release does not claim to resolve every historical Qt fault.

Firmware355, control/safety thresholds, saved calibration/SysID and the disabled
universal Git lock are unchanged. Source, pinouts, engineering guides, compilers
and credentials remain excluded from the operator installer. Compiled software
can still be copied or reverse engineered. Independent operating/fleet/physical
qualification remains separate. This unsigned build uses the accepted publisher
warning policy; public download remains URL/size/SHA256 verified.
